entries.a9126e5608e2bde4: This business operates movie theaters and restaurants and is the largest business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥3,654 million (of which ¥3,484 million related to movie theaters and ¥170 million to restaurants). It operates 'Midland Square Cinema' and 'Midland Square Cinema 2' in Nakamura Ward, Nagoya, and 'Midland Cinema Nagoya Airport' in Toyoyama Town, Nishikasugai District, Aichi Prefecture. Midland Square Cinema is operated through a joint venture with Shochiku Multiplex Theaters Co., Ltd. (the company's share of the partnership's assets is 64%). In its restaurant-related operations, it runs the café 'Kakuozan Café Ji.Coo.' in Chikusa Ward, Nagoya, and sells food and drinks inside movie theaters.

entries.c7aaaa5c19583264: Its basic management policy is to contribute to the local community through service businesses and provide customers with memorable services. Because the core Cinema Business shows large divergence between forecasts and results depending on the film, it does not set specific management indicators as management targets, and its policy is to work to strengthen a stable earnings base. In the cinema division, it sets out a focus on screening high-quality films and programming that meets needs, screenings with original events, and exhibition of digital content other than films; in the Real Estate Leasing Business, it aims to expand through Clinic Terrace Kakuozan 2, scheduled for completion in July 2026, and by raising rent levels at existing properties.

entries.cd39a07881d2134b: This business produces signboards and conducts advertising agency operations, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥344 million. It works to win new orders through proposal-based sales tailored to customer needs, and also takes on film promotion work on commission.
entries.d533e13a550ebafe: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, while national box office revenue in Reiwa 7 set an annual record, the annual box office of Midland Square Cinema also set a record, and revenue rose 22.5% from the previous year to ¥4,123 million. In the Real Estate Leasing Business, rental income from the medical mall Clinic Terrace Kakuozan, completed in February 2025, was recorded throughout the period, and revenue rose 53.0% from the previous year to ¥124 million.
